svg.title: Benchmark changes against main: Tessera 10 slower · 16 faster
svg.desc: u32 · random · 1,000,000: Tessera +37.9% regression; u64 · sorted · 48: Tessera +17.3% regression; {u64,u32} · sorted · 48: Tessera +17.2% regression; u64 · all equal · 48: Tessera +17.0% regression; u64 · 1% far swaps · 65,536: Tessera +11.9% regression; u64 · 99% one key · 1,000: Tessera +9.4% regression; {u64,u32} · sorted + tail · 65,536: Tessera +9.3% regression; u64 · 4,096 values · 65,536: Tessera +9.2% regression; f64 · sorted · 1,000: Tessera −78.8% improvement; u32 · sorted · 1,000: Tessera −73.5% improvement; u64 · sorted · 1,000: Tessera −68.5% improvement; u64 · random · 49: Tessera −42.5% improvement; u32 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −41.1% improvement; u64 · reverse · 65,536: Tessera −35.6% improvement; {u32,u32} · random · 49: Tessera −33.3% improvement; {u64,u32} · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −30.5% improvement; f64 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −28.5% improvement; u64 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −26.7% improvement; u64 · reverse · 48: Tessera −24.1% improvement; {u64,u32} · reverse · 48: Tessera −20.2% improvement; {u64,u32} · random · 1,000: Tessera −9.3% improvement; u64 · random · 1,000: Tessera −9.1% improvement; u32 · random · 65,536: Tessera −5.8% improvement; {u32,u32} · random · 1,000,000, par-4: Tessera +13.8% regression; {u32,u32} · 99% one key · 1,000,000, par-4: Tessera +7.2% regression; u64 · reverse · 1,000,000, par-4: Tessera −35.6% improvement
